title: Friendly.jar
description: This mod is more than just a collection of mechanics. It's fragments of something that was never meant to be in the game.
body:
ATTENTION!!!

This mod is not a virus and will not harm your computer. All events occur ONLY in the game(your world)!

Imagine, you create your new world, but an unknown player comes to you, who wants to be friends with you. And you have two options: play with him, or kick him out? The choice is yours, but remember, the second option is not the best...

This mod will add you a friend who wants to become his friend, but if you offend him (kill him), then your game will begin, in which you need to live 5 days, and 1-4 days your world will be infected with a "virus" (this is not a virus, but just visual effects). And already on the 5th day, you need to fight him (the boss). Good luck because the boss is not easy.
